data.title: Government of Canada announces funding for Small Craft Harbours in Val-Comeau and McEachern’s Point (Wishart Point)
data.author: Fisheries and Oceans Canada
data.summary: Val-Comeau, New Brunswick - Small craft harbours are vital infrastructure for coastal and rural communities, supporting fishing, transportation, and the local economies built around them. Billions of dollars in fish and seafood are landed at these harbours every year. Canada’s commercial fisheries, aquaculture, and seafood processing sectors support nearly 68,000 jobs, including more than 36,500 commercial fish harvesters and crew from coast to coast to coast. In 2025, Canada’s fish and seafood exports totaled $8.47 billion.

data.title: Minister Hodgson unveils first-ever federal strategy for Canada's forest sector
data.author: Natural Resources Canada
data.summary: Today, the Honourable Tim Hodgson, Minister of Energy and Natural Resources, announced the release of the country’s first-ever Forest Sector Strategy for Canada. This plan is supported by a proposed investment of $6.5 billion in Budget 2026, marking this the largest federal investment in the history of Canada’s forest sector. Together with measures announced since August 2025, the Government of Canada has committed more than $9 billion to supporting Canada's forest sector and its workers today and for the long term.

https://www.canada.ca/en/natural-resourc.label: Minister Hodgson unveils first-ever federal strategy for Canada's forest sector

data.title: Forest Sector Strategy for Canada: Investments in British Columbia
data.author: Natural Resources Canada
data.summary: Today, the Honourable Tim Hodgson, Minister of Energy and Natural Resources Canada, announced the release of the country’s first-ever strategy for the forest sector. The Forest Sector Strategy for Canada is supported by a proposed investment of $6.5 billion in Budget 2026, marking the largest federal investment Canada’s forest sector history. Minister Hodgson, on behalf of the Honourable Minister Gregor Robertson, Minister of Housing and Infrastructure and Minister responsible for Pacific Economic Development Canada, announced up to $31.6 million for forest sector projects and businesses in British Columbia, which includes an investment of $19.2 million from PacifiCan. Some funding remains subject to approval and final due diligence.

https://www.canada.ca/en/natural-resourc.label: Forest Sector Strategy for Canada: Investments in British Columbia
